text:
[IARC.3.13.1] One header: `libds.h`. Everything an integrator
sees lives in that one file — engine lifecycle,
opaque handles, slot-value tagged union, schema-
registry surface, fact assert / retract, pump, the
typed event payloads (`ds_log_event_t`,
`ds_metric_t`, etc.), the typed
callback signatures, and the per-area `set_*_callback`
setters. Internal module headers (`engine.h`,
`wm.h`, etc.) are not reachable via the public `-I`
path.
